title: SMB share observation (v1)
description: A share exposed by a server. A share is a publication of a directory, not the directory itself: two shares can expose one path with different share ACLs, and a share can be re-pointed without the directory changing. The UNC path is deliberately absent: it is exactly \\<server_name>\<share_name>, and carrying it as well would create a second identity that can disagree with the first.

is_special.description: The SMB server's own Special flag: this share is administrative or system-created (C$, ADMIN$, IPC$). Added in 1.1. It is a source fact and cannot be derived - hidden-ness follows from a trailing '$' in the name, but an ordinary hidden share such as Data$ is not Special. Null means the source did not say, which is not the same as false.
